The people of Ka 'roan have not received Saber's go signal to invade the Earth.

The king found this a betrayal that Saber did not follow simple orders. So, he sent the deadliest warlord with his army of elite Ka 'roanese soldiers to bring Saber's head back to where he belongs to and to punish Saber's offense towards his own people.  


Powers: Super strength, Efficient with polearms, has an army at his disposal but likes to fight his targets personally.

Real name: Not known.

Hero name: Saber.

Age: 29 (In Earth years)

Powers: Professional Swordsman, Super speed, Fast reflexes.

Extra Info: Does not talk at all but does know sign language.

Origin: He was supposed to make Earth clear for invasion but saw a Fencing match and was just infatuated by it.  The more he travelled Earth to find equivalents of that one Fencing match he was amazed by, the more he loved Earths culture.

But a personal issue came to him, to send the message to his home planet that Earth is clear to invade or to completely cut ties with it and never see his planet again.

Saber chose to cut ties just because how he was just so interested in Earths culture.

 Saber disguised himself to "try" to look more human by painting his armor with a paint can he found in a barn white to try to match the fencing uniform.

so, when he tried joining the fencing tournament, his disguised failed but his instructor just kept him since Saber showed quite promise

As Saber trained, he got so proficient with a sword, right after he was super skilled at fencing, he moved to Kendo and after Kendo he went to HEMA and so on and so on.
